                continue
            if any(skip in name for skip in ["embed", "lm_head", "norm"]):

            layer_num = None

                    break
            if layer_num is not None and layer_num >= 2:
                continue

            all_magnitudes.append(param.data.abs().flatten())

        all_magnitudes = torch.cat(all_magnitudes)
        n_prune = int(all_magnitudes.numel() * args.target_sparsity)

        for name, param in prunable_params:

    tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)
